Biography of UPSC Topper Raghav Jhunjhunwala

Raghav Jhunjhunwala was born in Muzaffarpur, Bihar. He achieved success in the UPSC Civil Services Examination at 25 years of age. Growing up, his family deeply valued education and discipline. This environment helped shape his academic goals. His late father, Naveen Jhunjhunwala, and mother, Anju Devi Jhunjhunwala, supported his educational journey. His early life in Bihar and strong academic exposure motivated him toward higher education and the UPSC exam.

As per the marks released by the Union Public Service Commission, Raghav Jhunjhunwala secured All India Rank (AIR) 4 in the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2025 under the OBC category. The candidate scored 847 marks in the written (Mains) examination and 195 marks in the Personality Test (Interview), achieving a final total of 1042 marks. This strong performance helped Raghav Jhunjhunwala secure a place among the top rank holders in the UPSC CSE 2025.

Raghav Jhunjhunwala consistently showed strong academic performance throughout his education. He finished his Class 10 education from D P S I Garhan Hathouri Sanathi, Muzaffarpur (CBSE), in 2017. He then completed his Class 12 from G.D. Mother International School, Muzaffarpur (CBSE), in 2019. For higher studies, he joined Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC), University of Delhi. There, he completed his B.A. (Hons) in Economics in 2022. During college, he earned the Charat Ram Gold Medal for his academic excellence. He also worked on a research paper about India's Non-Performing Assets (NPA) Crisis. This reflected his strong analytical skills.
UPSC Attempts and Strategic Optional Subject

Raghav Jhunjhunwala's path in the Civil Services Examination shows clear persistence and improvement. He took the UPSC Civil Services Preliminary Examination three times. These were in 2023, 2024, and 2025.

In his first attempt in 2023, he cleared the Preliminary stage. However, he did not qualify in the Mains examination. For his second attempt in 2024, he successfully cleared both the Preliminary and Mains stages. He then appeared for the interview round. Yet, he was not recommended in the final selection list. In his third attempt in 2025, he again cleared all stages of the exam. This time, he secured UPSC Rank 4 2026. This journey highlights the importance of steady effort and continuous learning in UPSC preparation.

Raghav Jhunjhunwala chose Economics as his optional subject for the UPSC Civil Services Mains Examination. This choice aligned well with his academic background, as he held a B.A. (Hons) in Economics from SRCC.
